import Mathlib

open scoped Nat

theorem witness : ∃ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), (0 : ℝ) ≤ f n) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℂ), (1 : ℝ) < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun (n : ℕ) => (↑(f n) : ℂ)) s) ∧
      (∃ (G : ℂ → ℂ),
          ContinuousOn G {s : ℂ | (1 : ℝ) ≤ s.re} ∧
            ∀ (s : ℂ), (1 : ℝ) < s.re → G s = LSeries (fun (n : ℕ) => (↑(f n) : ℂ)) s - (↑A : ℂ) / (s - (1 : ℂ))) ∧
        Continuous g ∧
          (∃ (C : ℝ), ∀ (u : ℝ), |g u| ≤ C / ((1 : ℝ) + u ^ (2 : ℕ))) ∧
            HasCompactSupport (FourierTransform.fourier fun (u : ℝ) => (↑(g u) : ℂ)) := by
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => le_rfl, ?_, ?_, continuous_const, ⟨0, fun u => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro s _
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero]
    exact LSeriesSummable_zero
  · refine ⟨fun _ => 0, continuousOn_const, fun s _ => ?_⟩
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_div, sub_zero]
    exact (congrFun LSeries_zero s).symm
  · simp
  · simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero]
    have h0 : (FourierTransform.fourier (fun (_ : ℝ) => (0 : ℂ))) = 0 := by
      funext w
      simp [Real.fourier_real_eq]
    rw [h0]
    exact HasCompactSupport.zero
